planA.name: Source-based editorial fallback
planA.summary: Re-edit only deterministic NASA geography, the already approved official C04 data plates and actual AX clips. Explicitly disclose no field/lab footage in 24–51s; do not imply a real operation.

segments.p: Extend coastal geography reference without depicting a ship, USV or field operation.
segments.edit: Hold the exact 24s coastal frame for six seconds. Use at most a 1.5% center-safe editorial push; do not invent intermediate geography.
segments.camera: Full 16:9 frame; keep all important coast/islands inside central 90%, no crop.
segments.in: Short dissolve from C04d on the same accepted 24s coast frame.
segments.out: Hard cut to deterministic 15s camera anchor; state that the edit changes reference frame, not actual field location.
segments.caption: At 24.0–25.5 add separate post text: “현장 촬영 자료 없음 · NASA 지리자료·공식 환경자료·실제 AX 화면 재편집”. NASA image is historical geography, not a live view.
segments.motion: Edit supplied 24s NASA-derived frame for six seconds. Lock every coast and Earth pixel. Only a 0–1.5% center-safe push and short dissolve are allowed; no generated pixels, vessel or live observation.
negative: No ship/USV, harbor operation, measurement, scan effect, invented site or live-satellite claim.

segments.p: Use deterministic Korea/NW Pacific camera-path references in place of field-sampling footage.
segments.edit: Hold the exact 15s frame 30.0–32.5, then hard-cut to the exact 18s frame 32.5–35.0. No synthetic in-between.
segments.camera: Full 2560×1440 in 16:9; no crop/warp. Keep Korea, Japan, east China coast and NW Pacific within central 90%.
segments.in: Hard cut from C05's coast frame; no claim of drone or surface movement.
segments.caption: Separate label: “NASA 기반 결정론적 지리·카메라 reference”. Never call it field footage or a survey result.
segments.motion: Sequence the supplied 15s and 18s deterministic NASA-texture frames as independent source anchors. Hold, then hard-cut; no generated motion/geography or crop.
negative: No spacecraft after the approach reference, vessel, UAV, field crew, new map, or observation result.

segments.p: Revisit the exact approved monthly SST plate as source visualization, not new measurement.
segments.edit: Hold full frame five seconds; use 0.25s whole-frame opacity dissolves only. Data plate is a unit.
segments.camera: Locked BBOX, full 16:9 source, no crop/parallax/data movement.
segments.out: Crossfade to Aquarius; no overlap showing both layers.
segments.caption: Post caption: “MODIS Aqua SST · monthly · 2012-08 · °C”. No new values or legend.
segments.motion: Show the exact approved SST source plate. Keep every pixel/color/coverage fixed; fade only the complete frame.
negative: No temperature values, altered colormap, smoothing or generated result.

segments.p: Show the approved coarse Aquarius salinity visualization without disguising resolution.
segments.edit: Hold exact full-frame plate four seconds and crossfade sequentially from SST and onward to chlorophyll. No added blur/interpolation.
segments.camera: Full 16:9, same BBOX/footprint; no crop, sharpening or additional smoothing.
segments.caption: Post caption: “Aquarius salinity · monthly · 2012-08 · psu”; note coarse source and derived color display, not measurement interpolation.
segments.motion: Present exact Aquarius source frame full-screen. Preserve native coarse pattern and mask; opacity transition only.
negative: No fake high-resolution appearance, new isolines or invented salinity values.

segments.p: Show the official daily MODIS Aqua L2 chlorophyll swath with observed gaps intact.
segments.edit: Hold exact approved plate four seconds; fade whole frame only and do not animate its mask.
segments.camera: Full 16:9 and original footprint; retain transparent no-data gaps.
segments.in: Crossfade from salinity, without layer stacking.
segments.out: Fade to actual AX clip sampler at 48.0.
segments.caption: Post caption: “MODIS Aqua L2 chlorophyll-a · daily swath · 2012-08-01 · mg/m³”; gaps mean unobserved coverage.
segments.motion: Hold the exact plate and source pixels fixed. Fade only the entire frame at its boundaries; fill nothing.
negative: No filled gaps, simultaneous-observation claim or generated concentration field.

segments.p: Bridge with existing actual AX screen captures; no actual laboratory source is available.
segments.edit: 48–49 Discover source 0–1s; 49–50 Predict source 0–1s; 50–51 Monitor source 0–1s. C11 uses the non-overlapping 1–2.5s of each same clip.
segments.camera: Each exact 1280×720 source, full 16:9, native speed; no crop or overlays.
segments.in: Hard cut from data plate to actual capture. Use separate slate/voiceover for context, not text over UI.
segments.out: Continue to C11 with the later non-overlapping portions; these are separate examples.
segments.caption: No overlay on UI. External disclosure: “실제 AX 화면 캡처 · 표시 상태는 촬영 당시”.
segments.motion: Edit the first second of each approved source clip in Discover, Predict, Monitor order at native speed. Preserve every UI pixel, full frame and source motion; reserve source 1–2.5s for C11.
negative: No generated UI, cursor, label, state, crop, retiming or repeated source frames in C11.
